definitions.gloss: national emblem; national coat of arms
definitions.explanation: The official symbol representing a country, used on passports, government documents, and official buildings. Distinct from the national flag.

examples.japanese: パスポートに{国章|こくしょう}が{印刷|いんさつ}されている。
examples.english: The national emblem is printed on the passport.

examples.japanese: {各国|かっこく}の{国章|こくしょう}には{動物|どうぶつ}が{使|つか}われることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Animals are often used in the national emblems of various countries.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{法律|ほうりつ}で{定|さだ}められた{国章|こくしょう}はなく、{菊|きく}の{紋章|もんしょう}が{事実上|じじつじょう}それにあたる。
examples.english: Japan has no national emblem established by law; the chrysanthemum crest serves as one in practice.

notes:
Formed from {国|こく} (country) plus {章|しょう} (badge, emblem), the same {章|しょう} as in {記章|きしょう} (badge) and {紋章|もんしょう} (crest).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国章|こくしょう}を{掲|かか}げる: to display the national emblem
- {国章|こくしょう}{入|い}りの{書類|しょるい}: documents bearing the national emblem

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国旗|こっき}: national flag — the cloth banner, not the emblem
- {紋章|もんしょう}: crest, coat of arms — general term covering family and institutional crests too
